title: Temperature Indicator using RGB LED
description: Use RGB LED to indicate temperature ranges (blue=cool, green=normal, red=hot) with NTC temperature sensor.
objectives: Read temperature from NTC sensor module (OUT → A0)
Control RGB LED colors (R→11, G→10, B→9)
Map temperature ranges to colors (blue < 20°C, green 20-30°C, red > 30°C)
Use analogWrite for RGB brightness control
